mapper.sql: s.id, s.workspace_id, s.created_by_user_id, s.title, s.title_user_set, s.visibility, s.status, CASE WHEN s.created_by_user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned_by_current_user, s.last_message_at, s.archived_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (workspace_id, created_by_user_id, title, title_user_set, visibility, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{createdByUserId}, #{title}, #{titleUserSet}, #{visibility}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE ai_chat_session
title = #{title}, title_user_set = TRUE,
status = #{status}, archived_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'archived' THEN COALESCE(archived_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END,
WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session_participant (workspace_id, session_id, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO ai_chat_message (workspace_id, session_id, seq, author_kind, author_user_id, content, structured_json, input_tokens, output_tokens) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{authorKind}, #{authorUserId}, #{content}, #{structuredJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{outputTokens,jdbcType=INTEGER})
INSERT INTO ai_chat_turn (workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestedByUserId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, session_id, requested_by_user_id, status, terminal_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_chat_turn WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND status IN ('queued', 'running') ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_tool_call (workspace_id, message_id, tool_name, status, arguments_json, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{messageId}, #{toolName}, #{status}, #{argumentsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{idempotencyKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND tc.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.status = 'proposed' ORDER BY tc.id ASC

SELECT tc.id, tc.workspace_id, tc.message_id, m.session_id, m.author_user_id AS requested_by_user_id, tc.tool_name, tc.status, tc.arguments_json, tc.result_json, tc.executed_by_user_id, tc.executed_at, tc.idempotency_key, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND m.id = tc.message_id WHERE tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_tool_call SET result_json = #{resultJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, executed_by_user_id = #{executedByUserId}, executed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'executed'
